subject.title: feat(gateway): pre-handshake WS verifyClient with Sec-Fetch-Site and forwarded-header hardening

question: Should Gateway WebSocket hardening use this new pre-handshake verifier and three public settings, and which checks—if any—should be unconditional rather than opt-in?
rationale: This changes the unauthenticated network boundary and establishes permanent configuration behavior; code review alone cannot choose the intended security-versus-compatibility policy or its canonical owner.

options.title: Approve a corrected verifier
options.body: Keep the pre-handshake layer, make every new rejection explicitly opt-in, inspect raw duplicate headers, and require real upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate admission policy
options.body: Move the hardening into a shared canonical origin/proxy policy so pre- and post-handshake paths cannot diverge.

options.title: Pause for related policy work
options.body: Defer or close this PR until the related Gateway origin-policy work establishes the permanent configuration and admission boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve a corrected verifier
recommendation.body: Keep the pre-handshake layer, make every new rejection explicitly opt-in, inspect raw duplicate headers, and require real upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion directly identifies steipete as the decision owner for gate placement and setting names on this Gateway security boundary.
